text:
Claire: Quick heads-up — planning a 60min OSS mini-workshop to showcase the tiny-refapp + a short benchmark narrative, plus a follow-up blog post and webinar page. Need owners for landing copy, benchmark visuals, demo repo walkthrough, and inbound routing. Draft plan here: https://docs.google.com/example :eyes:
Alejandro: 👍 dates? I can do the benchmark graphs and perf table. Prefer the week of May 12. Will need sample queries and env details from eng team.
Sam: I can take landing page + announcement copy. Will draft TL;DR + tweet thread. Target: first draft by Fri.
Jen: For inbound routing — recommend single signup form that writes to HubSpot list + tags leads with `oss_mini_workshop_2025`. SDR queue would be `oss-inbound`. Can add immediate autoresponder + repo link.
Maria: I’ll prep the hands-on tutorial in the refapp repo and a 10m demo video. Also propose a short sandbox link for attendees to try the refapp live.
Claire: Format idea: 20m demo (Maria), 20m benchmark deep-dive (Alejandro), 15m product/rollout + Q&A (Claire/Sam). Works?
Sam: Works. I'll also prep a 3-slide TL;DR for social sharing + a short checklist for docs team.
Alejandro: For benchmarks I’ll need: dataset summary, sequence lengths, and target models. Can someone drop the 3 sample prompts and the CSV of runtimes into the doc?
Claire: @Alejandro — I'll add the prompts. @Sam — can you coordinate with eng for runtime CSV?
Sam: Yep, pinging eng-runtime channel now.
Jen: Routing snippet we discussed (for engineering notes):
```
- form_id: "oss-mini-workshop"
- hubspot_list: "OSS Mini Workshop 2025"
- tag: "oss_mini_workshop_2025"
- sdr_queue: "oss-inbound"
- autoresponder: "workshop_confirm_v1"
```
Jen: Also propose UTMs: utm_source=community, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=tiny-refapp-may2025
Maria: Re: demo — I’ll record two short clips: (1) quick setup (2) feature walkthrough. Will drop timestamps in the doc and a short runbook for the host.
Claire: Owners recap: Sam=landing+social, Alejandro=benchmarks+graphs, Maria=demo+tutorial+repo, Jen=forms+routing+email. I’ll own comms + event page. Deadline: first drafts by Fri EOD.
calendar-bot: Event created — "tiny-refapp: OSS mini-workshop" on 2025-05-14 16:00 UTC (added Claire, Maria, Alejandro, Sam, Jen)
Sam: Quick ask — can we have a tiny code sandbox link (Repl or CodeSandbox) embedded in landing? It improves conversions.
Jen: Agree. We'll include sandbox link in autoresponder and confirmation email. Also will set lead-score +10 for attendance.
Alejandro: For the bench narrative, I want one slide highlighting cost/latency tradeoffs and one slide comparing caching + batching improvements. Will mockup in figma.
Claire: Great — if you hit any blocker post your ask here. Target review call next Tue 14:00 UTC. :rocket:
